candidates.desc: A young man in a white T-shirt and jeans runs across a wide mountain meadow of tall golden grass and small wildflowers at sunset. A young woman with long brown hair, also in a white top and jeans, runs into his arms from the other side. They put their arms around each other tightly and turn round together, her hair flying out in the wind, then stand still, holding each other close. The low sun shines behind them over forested hills and distant mountains.

An animated woman in a green suit stands at a wooden podium with a microphone in a grand hall and gives a heartfelt speech; she gestures, toasts to the next ten years, and the seated audience smiles and applauds.

Three friends with popcorn leave the crowded rows near the stage of an open-air amphitheater and climb the stairs all the way up, then sit happily in a completely empty row at the back, far from the concert.

A 3D-animated woman on a flower-covered rooftop balcony answers her phone and has a lively, joyful call with a friend, gasping, laughing and finally promising to see them soon before hugging the phone.
A man and a woman throw an orange ball back and forth on a sunny beach, each catching it in the air; the man dives into the sand to catch a long throw and they high-five and laugh.
In a hand-painted anime garden at night with paper lanterns, a girl blows out the candles on her birthday cake while two friends clap; a confetti popper goes off and the three hug and cheer.

Two animated teenagers find their seats in a dark movie theater with a bucket of popcorn. They watch a space cartoon on the big screen, gasp and laugh with wide eyes while munching popcorn in the red seats.

At an open-air concert in a park at sunset, a band plays on a small stage with bunting while a cheering crowd claps and raises their arms; a young woman with a bandana sings along, and a small dog sits on someone's shoulder.

At a night funfair, a man in a bright yellow shirt drives a red bumper car, shouts with joy as he crashes into his friends' bumper cars again and again, and finally cheers into the camera with both arms raised.
A woman cooking in a retro kitchen starts swaying and twirling her colorful skirt; her partner joins her and the two dance salsa together around the kitchen, ending with a laughing dip.

A young couple stands on a bed in a sunny attic bedroom and starts a pillow fight, swinging and blocking with big white pillows. A pillow bursts, feathers explode everywhere, and they collapse laughing on the feather-covered bed, one conceding that the other wins.

In a cozy anime apartment on a rainy evening, a host in an apron opens the door to a woman who arrives with a potted flower as a gift; he takes her wet coat, leads her to a candlelit table, drapes her napkin and pours her water before they toast.

At airport arrivals an excited man waits with a small gift as a young woman drops her suitcase and runs to him; they crash into a huge spinning hug and hold each other tight, laughing that they missed each other.
At a picnic in a poppy field, a young woman blows a kiss to her boyfriend; he playfully catches it, kisses her hand, and then gently kisses her forehead.

At sunset a group of friends holds a garden party with bunting, balloons, a snack table and lemonade; they dance on the grass with a dog running around, throw confetti and raise their cups in a toast.

At a sunny outdoor swimming pool ringed by pink flowering bushes, a woman relaxes on an orange inflatable ring while two guys cannonball off the edge one after another, sending up huge splashes and laughter. Afterwards the men float on their backs beside her in the turquoise water.

A young man in a cafe drops into a chair, puts his muddy boots up on the table next to his croissant, and stays glued to his phone while the waitress serves him; he mutters a dismissive remark instead of thanking her and later shoves past other customers on his way out.

Outside a bar at night a bearded man smokes a cigarette and taps the ash into an ashtray; nearby a woman lights an older woman's cigarette, and the smokers stand together puffing clouds under the street lights.

A woman arrives at her office desk and finds a coffee, a fresh bun and a smiley-face sticky note that someone left for her; she scans the open-plan office and questions a coworker trying to work out who it was, then gives up and happily sips the coffee holding the note.

At night a group of young men stand on a concrete ledge above a river, lighting the scene only with their phone torches. One of them takes off, tucks into a front flip and lands on a round trampoline set on the dirt below. The others lean over the ledge, sweeping their torch beams into the blackness, and two pale animal shapes appear far off on the track.

A convertible car drives at night along a resort road lined with lit palm trees and low houses. Inside, a young man drives with one hand on the wheel and a young woman in a pale yellow cardigan sits beside him; they glance at each other and smile. She reaches across and lays her hand palm up on his knee, he takes it, and they hold hands over the centre console. The last shot is a close-up of their two hands raised together with the fingers interlocked.

At night on a city pavement in front of a brick wall, a woman in a black dress and black high heels holds a bottle of champagne with both hands, laughing. She works the cork loose and the bottle erupts: a thick white jet of foam shoots several metres into the air and rains back down over the pavement. She screams, crouches down and holds the gushing bottle out in front of her at arm's length while the foam keeps fountaining up and spreads in a wide white pool across the paving stones.

A circus arena in a spotlight, with rows of the audience in silhouette. A performer in a blue costume stands on a gold pedestal and lifts a huge sheet of white cloth above their head, then opens their arms so the cloth falls into an enormous cone around them, spreading across the ring like a gown. The crowd hold up phones to film. The white cloth is then whipped away and in its place a giant peacock tail opens out in orange, white and green with a blue wheel at its centre, and the audience raise their hands and cheer.

An animated park scene with cartoon pigeons. A small grey pigeon stands beside a much larger dark blue pigeon that leans over it; the small one glares up with narrowed eyes. A white pigeon with pink feathers stands next to it, half-closing her eyes. The camera holds close on the small grey pigeon while its eyebrows lower and its face turns sour. At the end the white pigeon leans in and presses her beak to its cheek in a kiss; the grey pigeon's cheeks turn bright red and it keeps scowling while blushing.

An animated city street at sunset. A young woman with long black hair, a black leather jacket, cream trousers and a small red shoulder bag walks along the pavement, smiling and touching her hair. Ahead of her a young man in a leather jacket leans against a black car holding a huge bouquet of pink and cream peonies. She sees him, stops, and covers her mouth with her hand, eyes wide. He steps forward and holds the flowers out to her; she buries her face in the bouquet, then they stand close together behind the flowers, smiling at each other in the golden light.

A white-haired woman in a blue blouse sits at a table behind a large white cake with blue piping and three silver candles shaped as a 1, a 0 and a 0. Hands hang a colourful HAPPY BIRTHDAY banner on the black wall behind her and balloons show at the edges of the frame. Wearing a small tiara and a pair of pixel sunglasses, she blows the candles out one after another and then laughs at the camera.

In an empty car park at sunset an old woman in a bright pink cardigan sits on a red mobility scooter. Someone in front of her holds out a round turquoise cake covered in rainbow sprinkles on a white board and presses silver 1, 0 and 0 candles into the icing. She drives the scooter after the cake, laughing, and reaches out both hands for the plate as it is held towards her.

A cafe table by a window. A man in a camel coat and a woman in a black polo neck both freeze open-mouthed as spilled drink spreads across the wooden table and soaks the open sketchbook in front of her. He leans in talking fast, pulls napkins from the holder and blots the wet page, then lifts the book clear. He comes back with a cup of coffee, sets it down in front of her and speaks with his hands open; she turns to him and smiles.

A man sits at a small street bar as a bottle of beer is slid to him across the wooden counter. Inside, under coloured lights, a barman shakes a metal shaker and strains an orange drink into a wide glass in front of him. The clip ends on a rooftop at dusk where a group of friends have come together along a long marble counter under strings of bulbs and all reach in to clink their glasses.

An older man in a flat cap sits on a wooden bench in a park, opens a paper bag of grain and scatters it on the path, and pigeons crowd around his feet. The shot moves to a seafront promenade with palm trees, where he sits on a metal bench by the blue sea with the bag still in his hand, and then he is sitting shoulder to shoulder with two other older men on the bench, all of them talking and laughing together.

A woman in a green dress sits at a long wooden dining table that has already been laid with plates and cutlery. She strikes a match and holds it to the wick of a tall cream candle in a grey holder until it catches. She then works her way down the table lighting one candle after another with the match. In the last shots the room is dark, the whole row of candles is burning down the middle of the laid table, and she sits at the end of it looking down the table and smiling, waiting for her guests.

A birthday party in a small flat decorated with paper chains, fairy lights and balloons. A woman in a pink dress and a silver party hat stands in the doorway while friends hold a white and black drip cake in front of her and light the row of candles. She closes her eyes for a second, then leans forward and blows the candles out; smoke rises from the cake, everyone throws up their arms and cheers, and her friends crowd in to hug her around the table.

A run of street-dance scenes. A breakdancer flips upside down on a sunny city plaza inside a ring of people who clap and film him. Then women in wide rainbow-coloured folk skirts spin in the middle of a street while onlookers press in on both sides. Next about ten dancers move as one down the aisle of a shopping centre, with shoppers gathering along the sides. Finally the camera lifts to show hundreds of people filling a whole city square at dusk, all dancing the same steps in rows that run back to the buildings.

A room is being decorated for a party. Two hands press a paper chain against a white wall, running through red, orange, yellow, green and blue links. Pale pink and deep blue balloons are stuck to the wall above a grey sofa. The rainbow chain is then strung in a curve above a row of grey triangular bunting. In the evening the room is lit up: a man on a stepladder hangs bright garlands under a canopy of fairy lights while a woman holds a pink balloon, and the whole floor disappears under hundreds of pink, blue, orange, yellow and silver balloons.

A young man in a black jacket stands in a hallway looking at his phone with a pained face as he apologises. In the kitchen behind him another young man in a stained apron is serving a hot pan of stew onto a table laid for three, under a paper banner reading 'Congratulations'. The friend leaves through the door; the cook is left standing alone at the table, then sits down by himself in front of the untouched dish and the single candle.

A young man puts his mouth close to a window furred with white frost and breathes hard on the glass until a clear round hole opens in it and his face shows through. He is then at a party with friends around him, leaning over a birthday cake covered in lit candles; he purses his lips, breathes out hard and the flames go out. Next he leans over a row of coloured paper party blowers on a white table and puffs them so they uncoil and shoot out one after another. Finally a long table crowded with dozens of candles and a room full of friends all lean in and puff together, then cheer with their arms up under the streamers and fairy lights.

A plain office with a venetian blind. A man and a woman sit side by side at a wooden table, each with their own printed document and pen in front of them, and each signs their own sheet. They then twist the wedding rings off their fingers and set the two rings down on the bare table between the papers. Both stand, turn away from each other, and walk out of the room through two different grey doors, leaving the two documents, the two pens and the two rings behind on the table.

A young woman with curly hair carries a small chocolate cake with one lit candle up behind a young man sitting indoors; he turns and his mouth falls open. The scene cuts to an outdoor basketball court at sunset where he dribbles a ball with the low sun behind him, then to the same woman standing under the hoop holding up a handmade sign with a red heart on it and cheering. In the last shots the two of them stand face to face with white cake frosting smeared over their cheeks and chins, laughing, then lean into the camera together with a lit dome and Paris rooftops behind them.

A large family party in a house hung with cut-paper bunting. A man holds out a wrapped present with a purple bow to a very old woman, who takes it with both hands while relatives watch and smile. She is then handed an open tin of chocolate-chip cookies by a middle-aged woman in a floral shirt. A young woman opens a photo album and gasps at a picture inside while an older man looks over her shoulder. In the final shots the whole family crowds around a table loaded with food and passes small wrapped boxes from hand to hand across it.

Two young women meet face to face in a club with purple and pink neon lights behind them. They are wearing exactly the same patterned mini dress, and they stare at each other's dress with their mouths open. The blonde one shouts angrily at the other, then her face breaks into a smile as they talk it over; the dark haired one starts to cry and laugh at once, and the two of them fall into a long hug in their matching dresses.

A young woman in a white summer playsuit sits on the edge of a bed typing on her phone with both thumbs and grinning at the screen. She carries on reading and typing standing in a bright kitchen, laughing at what she reads. Back in the bedroom she sits cross legged on the bed holding the phone and beaming into the camera, then throws herself backwards onto the covers kicking her legs in the air, and finally pulls the white duvet right over herself so only a foot sticks out.

A dark room where someone is pressed behind a heavy beige curtain with only a hand showing at the gap. Cut to an office, where a grinning man in a blue polo shirt is folded up under a desk with his arms round his knees. Then a small boy in a red shirt presses himself against a wide tree trunk in a park and peers round it with wide eyes. A quiet living room with an empty fireplace swings past, and finally a whole group of people leap up from behind a sofa with their arms in the air as confetti falls.

On a city square a small group of friends huddles in a tight group hug with their arms around each other; passers-by walk over and wrap their arms around the outside, and more and more people keep attaching themselves until a large mass of people is pressed into one huge hug.

A young man in a waistcoat and shirt opens the door of his flat and waves people in. He gathers their coats in his arms and hangs them on hooks in the hall. In the kitchen he slides two tall glasses of sparkling water across the counter towards the camera. At a candlelit table set with pasta, salad, bread and wine, the guests laugh together; he stands at the head of the table and lifts his glass to them.

A young woman in an oversized beige sweater stands on a city pavement beside a pastel coffee kiosk, looking down at her phone. She glances up at a man in a denim jacket and her face opens in recognition; both of them point at each other and start talking. They shake hands warmly next to the kiosk window, then stand facing each other holding takeaway coffee cups and carry on chatting.

A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks away from the camera across a car park towards a modern hospital with a red cross sign, carrying tulips and a round balloon, with an ambulance parked at the side. She goes through the sliding glass doors, along a long white corridor past open ward doors, and pushes open the door of a patient room. Inside, a young woman in a hospital gown is sitting up in bed; she claps her hands and beams when she sees the flowers and the balloon.

A woman in a chunky cream jumper paddles a red canoe straight toward the camera across a huge, glassy blue lake. The drone pulls back and up and she is the only person on the water. She reaches a tiny rock island with a single pine tree on it, steps out and stands there by herself, the whole scene mirrored in the still water.

At a Paris cafe two young women in coats lean in close over a marble bistro table holding two cappuccinos. Then an elderly couple at a cafe table hold each other's faces and kiss. Next a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man leaning the woman backwards, and they end in a long hug on the pavement while cafe guests watch.

In a university lecture room a student with bright blue hair looks at something on his phone and starts laughing. The classmates around him crack up too, one throwing his head back, until the whole room is roaring. Then a teacher walks in and stands at the whiteboard, the class sits back down at their laptops, and one boy is left lying on the floor between the desks still shaking.

A montage of people taking in sounds. A young man in a sunlit room wears big over-ear headphones, eyes closed and smiling as music plays. Two women sit over coffee in a cafe, one talking with her hand at her temple while the other leans in towards her. A man in a blue shirt presses the side of his face and a cupped hand against a closed office door in a corridor, eyes wide. Finally a festival crowd stands in front of a lit stage at dusk, some of them pressing their hands over their ears.

A wedding ceremony on a beach under a white rose arch, with the sea and cliffs behind. The bride, in a long white dress and a veil, slides a ring onto the groom's finger while he smiles down at her. He then takes her face in his hands and they kiss; the seated guests stand and applaud, and the two hold hands and laugh together under the arch.

A woman in an orange blazer walks into a bright open-plan office on her first day, carrying a cardboard box of desk things. One colleague after another steps up to shake her hand while she balances the box on one arm, and at the end the whole team stands around her, smiling and applauding as she shakes yet another hand.

A young man with a backpack holds his card against the reader at a gym turnstile; a green tick lights up and he walks through into the gym. The clip cuts to a library chess club, where a smiling elderly woman arrives at a table of chess boards, sits down, and the other players wave, make a move on the board and applaud her as one of them.

Three hikers with big backpacks stand at a wooden railing on the rim of the Grand Canyon under a clear blue sky. One after another they cup their hands round their mouths and yell out over the canyon with their mouths wide open, then all three yell together with their arms flung out towards the drop.

A boy and a girl run through a living room, then whisper and laugh together under a white sheet stretched into a den. At a table they both grip the same chocolate-chip cookie and pull, faces screwed up, until it breaks into two halves and each keeps one. The clip ends in a sunny back garden where a big group of children run across the grass and then flop down in one laughing pile.

Two teenagers in a bedroom hold up a sparkly silver top and laugh, then lean into the camera and blow a kiss. One sits behind the other on the bed and plaits her hair. The clip cuts to a living room where about fifteen girls are packed onto a sofa and the floor, all shouting and laughing at the camera at the same time.

A young woman in a red blazer stands on a low wooden platform in a European city square and speaks into a microphone on a stand. A crowd presses around her, many of them filming with their phones. She gestures with one arm while she talks, then raises her fist and the crowd claps.

On a wet London street a young woman's sheets of paper are scattered across the road; a young man kneels down, gathers them up and hands them back, and she smiles at him. Later, at a bus stop in the rain, an older man in a suit holds his umbrella over her head and points out the right bus. A red double-decker pulls in, and as she steps aboard she turns back, waves and thanks him while he keeps the umbrella up.

Four short scenes of people speaking with each other. A man in a hoodie walks along a busy New York street with a phone at his ear, answering and gesturing with his free hand. Two women in a cafe lean towards each other over their cappuccinos, one telling something and the other reacting with wide eyes. An elderly woman and a middle-aged man stand on either side of a white picket fence in a sunny front garden and lean in to talk across it. Finally a family around a lit dinner table talk over each other, pointing and laughing.

At a long cafe table on a sunlit Italian piazza, a grey-haired woman in glasses turns to the young man beside her and makes a point with both hands while he answers her back. More friends arrive and sit down along the same table of espresso cups and water glasses, and each of them joins in, leaning forward, putting a view to the others and answering what is said, until the whole table is turned in towards the middle, gesturing and laughing.

A young woman with a long red braid and a young man carrying a pink and blue box walk up to a small blue wooden cottage buried in hanging flowers. The bright blue door opens and an old woman in a headscarf leans out, beaming at them; she comes onto the step and the two young people wrap her in a hug. Inside the low wooden kitchen they lift a cream cake out of its box onto a small table beside a jar of sunflowers, the young woman pours from a white kettle into enamel mugs, and all three lean over the cake together, laughing.

In a grand old library reading room with green banker's lamps and tall bookshelves, a student in a shirt and striped tie leans across the long table, cups his hand around his mouth and passes something on to the next person. One after another the students at the table turn sideways, listen, react with wide eyes and a smirk, and pass it along the row. The last shot shows the whole row of students leaning in and giggling over their open books.

Outdoors at sunset on a street basketball court beside a graffiti wall. A girl in a tie-dye set dances and dribbles a basketball while the friends around her clap and dance with her; the camera pulls back and the gathering keeps growing until a huge crowd fills the whole street, everyone dancing with their arms in the air, while a skateboarder rolls through the middle.

On a snowy cobbled street of colourful old houses beneath a forested hill on a bright winter day, a young man in a red wool jacket stands with a snow shovel after clearing the pavement, with heaps of snow along the road. From her doorstep a young woman with a dark braid, in a navy puffer jacket, hands him a glass of hot tea and presses her other hand to her chest in thanks. He takes the glass and drinks. A dachshund in a yellow knitted jumper sits on the step and a mint-green car is parked behind.

In a dim bar with a small stage, purple and blue stage lights and haze, a young man in a black vest sings loudly into a microphone on a stand with his head thrown back and eyes shut. Next to the stage a young woman in a silver sequined top and black skirt squeezes her eyes shut and covers both ears with her hands. A shaggy grey dog sits on the rug and howls up at him. The view moves closer to the three of them. A stool with a tambourine, a velvet sofa, a lamp and people with drinks fill the room.

On a city street at night in the rain, in front of a noodle shop window and a glowing neon restaurant sign, a laughing young woman in a red coat jumps into the arms of a young man in a black jumper and jeans. He holds her tight and spins her round, then sets her down. He takes her face in his hands, they smile at each other, and they rest their foreheads together, their hair wet from the rain. The wet pavement reflects pink and blue light.

In an empty roller-skating hall after a party, a young man in a blue padded vest, white T-shirt and black trousers smiles as he pushes a wide broom through a big pile of pink, gold and silver confetti and burst balloons on the wooden floor. Pink and silver balloons lie scattered around. Behind him a young blonde woman in a lilac top sits on a bench taking off her white roller skates and then stands up. A mirror disco ball hangs from the black ceiling, and pink and teal neon lights glow on the walls.

On a rooftop terrace in the evening, two young women who look almost exactly the same stand side by side, laughing and pointing at each other: both have long dark wavy hair, gold hoop earrings, dark green satin slip dresses and gold sandals. They lean together laughing, then turn to each other and hug. String lights hang overhead. Around them are a wicker daybed with patterned cushions, a carved wooden door, a green balustrade and patterned tiles, with city towers under a deep blue sky.

A wooden platform high in a rainforest tree at sunset. A young woman in a red dress, a white helmet and a climbing harness swings in on a zip line, lands on the platform and holds out a sunflower to a young man in a white shirt and beige trousers, who laughs and takes it. A table with a white cloth, a candle and glasses is set for two. A waiter holds a menu, a guide in black stands by the rope, two toucans land on the line, and paper lanterns hang above a misty waterfall.

A house party in a small kitchen. A young woman in a denim jacket and a black dress sticks out her tongue as she holds a small silver digital camera at arm's length, its flash firing, taking a selfie with friends who pull faces beside her. Then she lowers the camera and they all crowd round to look at its screen, laughing. A pizza box, a bowl of crisps, bottles and cans stand on the counter. Balloons are stuck on the fridge, fairy lights hang along the cupboards and people dance in the doorway.

An old stone lighthouse stands on black rocks in a storm, under grey clouds with a gap of golden light on the horizon. On the railed balcony at the top, a young couple in matching yellow raincoats hold each other close and kiss, while a huge white wave crashes up against the tower below them and then falls back, leaving water pouring off the rocks. Inside the glass lantern room behind them, a man watches beside the glowing lamp. Seagulls fly around the tower over the rough sea.

Inside a warm, old-fashioned bar. A man with short brown hair and a cream linen shirt lifts a bulldog in a striped knitted jumper from the bar edge and sets it down carefully on a round wooden bar stool, where it stands calmly. He lets go, steps back and gestures towards the dog. A newspaper and a set of keys lie on the marble counter beside a brass rail. Shelves of bottles glow behind the bar, a bartender works in the background, and other customers talk further along.

In a dark wood-panelled bistro in the evening, a young woman in a white satin dress and a young man in a cream suit sit at a small marble table, lean their heads together and laugh. Together they cut a small white cake decorated with sugar roses with one knife and then lift the knife up, smiling at each other. Glasses of sparkling wine, a candle, a vase of pink roses, a wrapped gift and a bunch of dried flowers stand on the table, and a rainy street glows through the window.

A hallway with blue walls and a patterned tiled floor. A young woman in a blue shirt and wide black trousers stands by the open front door with a travel bag and points casually through a doorway. In the bathroom behind it a large white swan stands in the roll-top bath. A young man in a green T-shirt sits on the arm of a sofa tying his shoe. The woman then lifts her bag, turns and walks out of the front door. Coats hang on hooks and botanical prints hang on the wall.

A young couple on a stone riverside bridge in Rome at sunset, with a great domed church on the skyline. The railing is covered in dozens of colourful padlocks. A young man in a white shirt throws a small key high into the air over the river, while a young woman in a lilac dress laughs and holds a padlock locked on the railing. He lowers his arm, and the two turn to each other and smile. A seagull stands on the wall and street lamps line the bridge.

A selfie at an outdoor music festival at sunset. Two young women press their cheeks together and laugh with wide open mouths: one with long braids in a blue crop top, the other with curly hair in a yellow halter top. Colourful confetti swirls in the sky, the stage behind glows with coloured lights, and the crowd dances around them, one young man sitting on a friend's shoulders with his fist up, and a straw hat flies into the air. The sky is streaked pink and orange.

A selfie in a park in spring after rain. A smiling young woman with long dark hair in a lilac top and white pleated skirt holds the phone at arm's length. Behind her a young man in a white T-shirt holds his denim jacket over her head like a roof and kisses her gently on the cheek, then smiles at her as she laughs. Pink cherry blossom petals drift through the air from a flowering tree, puddles shine on the path, and other people sit and play on the grass behind them.

A warmly lit flat as the evening begins, the sky outside the window deep purple with city lights coming on. A smiling young man with a short beard in a shiny royal blue shirt over a white T-shirt and cream trousers takes a mirror selfie, straightens his collar and poses, dressed to go out. Behind him by the open door another young man crouches to tie his shoes, then stands up and waits. A glass pendant lamp glows over a wooden cabinet with a plant and a bottle of scent.

A sunny living room the morning after a party. A young woman with messy hair and pink pyjamas sits on a yellow sofa, laughing as she holds up a gold paper crown and a balloon, then looks at the crown and throws her arms up with a shout. Balloons, streamers and confetti are scattered over the parquet floor, and a round cake sits on the coffee table. A ginger cat curls up on a cushion, and behind the sofa a young man in a cream T-shirt pulls down a long streamer to tidy up.

A knife cuts into a round chocolate cake with a single burning gold candle. A young woman in a brown leather jacket is cutting it at a wooden counter, and a young man in a navy jacket stands close beside her. Two full champagne glasses stand next to the cake, and city lights shine through a rainy window at night. They laugh and look at each other, then he puts his arm around her and they kiss. The one candle shows that it is their first anniversary: one year together.
